caption:
Brands are dropping millions on creators, but paying them still looks like splitting a pizza bill on Venmo. Spreadsheets and manual apps are not a payment strategy. When are we going to treat creator pay like actual business? Drop your thoughts below. 👇

Source: Digiday

post.news: Celebrity ad pay in the US is projected to hit $2.06 billion in 2026. Yet brands still pay creators using spreadsheets and Venmo.
post.take: We are funding million-dollar creator campaigns using business models left behind in a group chat.
post.insight: Creator budgets are growing fast, but the payment systems are stuck in the stone age.
